inclusion_rule: Speech recognizers (text output) whose test input is a skin-, bone- or tissue-conducted acoustic sensor on the talker (throat or contact microphone, bone-conduction microphone, NAM or stethoscopic microphone, accelerometer), in any speaking mode; design compared is the body site of the sensor. Boundary: enhancement or conversion without a recognizer, speaker recognition and reviews are excluded; air-microphone whisper recognizers belong to the M04 topic; multiple reports of one experiment count once; the 2004 Japanese and 2006 English versions of the target are merged.
